name: Batticaloa Coconut Estate
description: Discover the Batticaloa Coconut Estate, a lush tea plantation nestled in the Eastern Province's serene hills. Here, you can explore the traditional tea-making process and marvel at the picturesque landscapes, making it a perfect spot for nature lovers and tea enthusiasts alike.
activities: Explore the tea plantation, Learn about the tea-making process, Visit the local tea museum

name: Pasikuda Beach Garden
description: Pasikuda Beach Garden is a serene tea estate on Batticaloa’s eastern coast, offering breathtaking views of the Indian Ocean and lush tea plantations. Nestled among the rolling hills, this tranquil spot is perfect for nature lovers and tea enthusiasts.
activities: Tea plantation tour, bird watching, picnicking

name: Vakarai Organic Farm
description: Vakarai Organic Farm is a serene tea estate nestled in Batticaloa District, Eastern Province, known for its lush green landscapes, traditional tea-making process, and organic practices that attract both locals and tourists seeking a glimpse into Sri Lanka’s agricultural heritage.
activities: Tea plantation tour, organic tea tasting, photography

name: Chenkalady Spice Trail
description: Discover the Chenkalady Spice Trail, a serene tea estate nestled amidst lush greenery and vibrant flora. This historic site offers a glimpse into the traditional practices of Sri Lankan tea cultivation, making it a must-visit for tea enthusiasts and nature lovers alike.
monsoon_note: Oct–Jan NE monsoon; best season Apr–Sep
